transactions_account_conversion_consiste.name: transactions_account_conversion_consistent
transactions_account_conversion_consiste.value:
("transactions"."original_currency" = "transactions"."account_currency" AND "transactions"."account_fx_rate" IS NULL AND "transactions"."amount" = "transactions"."original_amount")
        OR ("transactions"."original_currency" <> "transactions"."account_currency" AND "transactions"."account_fx_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."account_fx_rate" > 0)

transactions_base_conversion_consistent.name: transactions_base_conversion_consistent
transactions_base_conversion_consistent.value:
("transactions"."original_currency" = "transactions"."base_currency" AND "transactions"."base_fx_rate" IS NULL AND "transactions"."base_amount" = "transactions"."original_amount")
        OR ("transactions"."original_currency" <> "transactions"."base_currency" AND "transactions"."base_fx_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."base_fx_rate" > 0)

transactions_conversion_traceable.name: transactions_conversion_traceable
transactions_conversion_traceable.value:
("transactions"."account_fx_rate" IS NULL AND "transactions"."base_fx_rate" IS NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."fx_source" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."fx_converted_at" IS NOT NULL)

transactions_direction_matches_type.name: transactions_direction_matches_type
transactions_direction_matches_type.value:
("transactions"."type" IN ('income', 'refund') AND "transactions"."direction" = 'inflow')
        OR ("transactions"."type" IN ('expense', 'fee') AND "transactions"."direction" = 'outflow')
        OR "transactions"."type" IN ('transfer', 'payment', 'investment')

transactions_transfer_group_rules.name: transactions_transfer_group_rules
transactions_transfer_group_rules.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."transfer_group_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "transactions"."type" IN ('payment', 'investment')
        OR ("transactions"."type" IN ('income', 'expense', 'refund', 'fee') AND "transactions"."transfer_group_id" IS NULL)
